'''María Josefa Yzuel Giménez''' (born 1940) is a professor of physics at the [[Autonomous University of Barcelona]]. She has worked in medical optics, diffraction image theory, image quality evaluation and liquid crystals. She served as president of [[SPIE]] in 2009.

== Early life and education ==
Yzuel was born in [[Jaca]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://espanaglobal.gob.es/en/current-news/innovation/spanish-science-has-female-name|title=Spanish science, has a female name|date=2019-02-11|website=Espana Global|access-date=2019-05-18}}</ref> She studied physical sciences at the [[University of Zaragoza]], from which she graduated in 1962. She remained there for her doctoral studies, and completed her PhD in 1966.<ref name="royal-spanish-society"/> In 1987 Yzuel was awarded a grant from the [[British Council]] to travel to the [[University of Reading]]. She was the only woman to earn this award and worked under the supervision of [[Harold Hopkins (physicist)|Harold Hopkins]].<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|url=http://www.uab.cat/web/newsroom/news-detail/mar-iacute-a-josefa-yzuel-to-receive-the-igualtat-2017-prize--1345668003610.html?noticiaid=1345720629797|title=María Josefa Yzuel to receive the igUAltat 2017 prize|last=Barcelona|first=UAB-Universitat Autònoma de|website=UAB Barcelona|language=en|access-date=2019-05-17}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=http://areajovensedoptica.blogspot.com/2014/08/|title=Área Joven de SEDOPTICA|website=areajovensedoptica.blogspot.com|language=es|access-date=2019-05-18}}</ref>

== Research and career ==
In 1971, Yzuel was appointed to the [[University of Zaragoza]], where she was the first woman in Spain to become a professor in physics.<ref name=":1">{{Cite web|url=https://spie.org/news/spie-professional-magazine/2009-january/prez-letter-yzuel|title=Light in Dark Times|website=spie.org|access-date=2019-05-18}}</ref> In 1983, Yzuel joined the [[Autonomous University of Barcelona]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.elsevier.com/connect/in-tunisia-optics-workshops-help-women-pursue-emerging-field|title=In Tunisia, optics workshops help women pursue emerging field|last=Elsevier|website=Elsevier Connect|language=en|access-date=2019-05-18}}</ref> Yzuel was the first woman to serve as president of the Spanish Optical Society in 1993.<ref name=":0" /> She was secretary general of the [[European Optical Society]] in 1996.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.radiohuesca.com/comarcas/maria-josefa-yzuel-reconocida-en-el-mundo-cientifico-y-ahora-tambien-en-su-provincia-16112018-117226.html|title=María Josefa Yzuel, reconocida en el mundo científico y ahora, también, en su provincia|last=RadioHuesca|website=Radio Huesca|date=16 November 2018 |language=es|access-date=2019-05-18}}</ref>

Yzuel worked on various optical systems as well as optical processing of information. She has demonstrated and developed [[spatial light modulator]]s for diffractive elements.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.uab.cat/web/newsroom/news-detail/mar-iacute-a-josefa-yzuel-gives-name-to-spie-international-prize--1345668003610.html?noticiaid=1345773695852|title=María Josefa Yzuel gives name to SPIE international prize|last=Barcelona|first=UAB-Universitat Autònoma de|website=UAB Barcelona|language=en|access-date=2019-05-18}}</ref> She retired in 2011, and remains at the Autonomous University of Barcelona as an emeritus professor.<ref name=":2">{{Cite web|url=https://www.susu.ru/en/university/governance/international-scientific-council|title=International Scientific Council - South Ural State University|website=www.susu.ru|access-date=2019-05-18}}</ref> She serves on the International Scientific Council of the [[South Ural State University]].<ref name=":2" />

Yzuel is committed to diversity in physics and supports many initiatives that champion women scientists.<ref>{{Cite conference|last1=Yzuel|first1=M. J.|last2=Peinado|first2=A.|editor2-first=Mourad|editor2-last=Zghal|editor1-first=Manuel F. P. C|editor1-last=Martins Costa|date=2014-07-17|title=Women in science: physics and optics|conference=12th Education and Training in Optics and Photonics Conference|volume=9289|pages=92892X|publisher=SPIE|doi=10.1117/12.2070740|bibcode=2014SPIE.9289E..2XY|url=https://www.spiedigitallibrary.org/conference-proceedings-of-spie/9289/92892X/Women-in-science-physics-and-optics/10.1117/12.2070740.pdf|doi-access=free}}</ref> She has been involved with the [[SPIE]] ''Women in Optics'' program as well as the Association of Women Researchers and Technologists.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://spie.org/about-spie/advocacy/women-in-optics/women-in-optics-planner/2005-wio-planner/yzuel-maria-josefa?SSO=1|title=Maria Josefa Yzuel -- 2005 SPIE Women in Optics Planner|website=spie.org|access-date=2019-05-18}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://epws.org/interview-month-association-women-researchers-technologists-052016/|title=Interview of the Month: Association of Women Researchers and...|last=EPWS|date=2016-05-02|website=European Platform of Women Scientists EPWS|language=en-US|access-date=2019-05-18}}</ref> She founded the women in physics section of the Royal Spanish Society of Physics.<ref name=":3">{{Cite web|url=https://spie.org/about-spie/press-room/spie-member-news/mar%C3%ADa-j-yzuel-receives-gender-equality-award---igualdad-2107?SSO=1|title=María Josefa Yzuel has been awarded the 2017 Gender Equality Award|website=spie.org|access-date=2019-05-18}}</ref>

== Awards and honours ==
Yzuel is a Fellow of [[The Optical Society]], the [[European Optical Society]], and [[SPIE]], and she is a Senior Academician of the Royal Academy of Sciences and Arts of Barcelona.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.osa.org/en-us/100/osa_stories/maria_yzuel/|title=Celebrating All Members Videos|website=OSA|access-date=2019-05-18}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.europeanoptics.org/pages/awards/eos-fellows.html|title=EOS fellows|website=www.europeanoptics.org|access-date=2019-05-18}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.icfo.eu/ca/newsroom/news/4342-fellow-of-the-royal-academy-of-science-and-arts-of-barcelona|title=Fellow of the Royal Academy of Science and Arts of Barcelona |website=www.icfo.eu|access-date=2019-05-18}}</ref>

Her other awards and honours include:
* 2005 SPIE Director's Award<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.spie.org/about-spie/awards-programs/awards-listing/spie-directors-award?SSO=1|title=Directors' Award - SPIE|website=www.spie.org|access-date=2019-05-18}}</ref>
* 2005 [[University of Warsaw]] Medal<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.icfo.es/images/carrousels/CLP/clp_flyer_2009.pdf|title=ICFO Corporate Liaison|website=ICFO|access-date=2019-05-18}}</ref>
* 2009 President of SPIE<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://spie.org/membership/student-services/visiting-lecturers-program/lecturer-directory/yzuel-maria?SSO=1|title=Maria Yzuel {{!}} SPIE Homepage: SPIE|website=spie.org|access-date=2019-05-17}}</ref><ref name=":1" />
* 2012 [[Miguel Hernández University of Elche]] Honorary Doctorate<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.uab.cat/web/noticias/detalle-de-una-noticia/m-josefa-yzuel-sera-investida-doctora-em-honoris-causa-/em-por-la-umh-1099409749848.html?noticiaid=1327476484148|title=M. Josefa Yzuel será investida doctora honoris causa por la UMH - UAB Barcelona|website=www.uab.cat|access-date=2019-05-18}}</ref>
* 2013 [[Civil Order of Alfonso X, the Wise]]<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.icfo.cat/newsroom/news/1889-order-of-alfonso-x-the-wise|title=Order of Alfonso X the Wise|website=www.icfo.cat|access-date=2019-05-18}}</ref>
* 2014 Medal of the Royal Spanish Society of Physics<ref name="royal-spanish-society">{{Cite web|url=https://spie.org/about-spie/press-room/spie-member-news/yzuel-royal-spanish-society-medial-1-29-15?SSO=1|title=María Yzuel awarded Medal of the Royal Spanish Society of Physics|website=spie.org|access-date=2019-05-17}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.fbbva.es/galardonados/maria-josefa-yzuel-gimenez/|title=María Josefa Yzuel Giménez|website=FBBVA|language=es|access-date=2019-05-18}}</ref>
* 2015 President of the Spanish Committee for the celebration of the [[International Year of Light]]<ref>{{Cite book|last1=Calvo|first1=María L.|last2=Yzuel|first2=María J.|last3=Moreno|first3=Ignacio|title=Optics Education and Outreach V |chapter=The first International Day of Light in Spain |editor1-first=G. * 2017 [[University of Alicante]] Gender Equality Award '''('''igUABlitat prize)<ref name=":0" /><ref name=":3" />
*2017 [[University of Granada]] Honorary Doctorate <ref>{{Cite web|url=https://archivo.ugr.es/pages/trabajosdocumentos/honoriscausa|title=Archivo Universitario > Doctores Honoris Causa investidos por la UGR {{!}} Universidad de Granada|website=archivo.ugr.es|access-date=2019-05-30}}</ref>
*2021 SPIE President's Award<ref>{{Cite web|title=María J. Yzuel: The 2021 SPIE President's Award|url=https://spie.org/news/maría-j-yzuel-2021-spie-presidents-award-|access-date=2021-02-16|website=spie.org}}</ref>

SPIE have offered a Maria J. Yzuel Educator Award in honour of Yzuel since 2003.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://spie.org/about-spie/awards-programs/awards-listing/spie-maria-j-yzuel-educator-award?SSO=1|title=Maria Yzuel Educator Award - SPIE|website=spie.org|access-date=2019-05-18}}</ref> In 2018, the Walqa Technology Park honoured Yzuel by naming one of their buildings after her.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://spie.org/about-spie/advocacy/women-in-optics/women-in-optics-planner/2005-wio-planner/yzuel-maria-josefa?SSO=1|title=Maria Josefa Yzuel -- 2005 SPIE Women in Optics Planner|website=spie.org|access-date=2019-05-18}}</ref> In 2019, [[ICFO – The Institute of Photonic Sciences|The Institute of Photonic Sciences]] announced the Maria Yzuel Fellowship Awards for women undergraduate and postgraduate students.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://spie.org/news/0329-maría-yzuel-fellowship-awards|title=ICFO launches María Yzuel Fellowship Awards|website=spie.org|access-date=2019-05-18}}</ref>
